newsitem.title: USA: Stella Bella buying food company.
newsitem.headline: Stella Bella buying food company.

text.p: Stella Bella Corp said it entered an all-cash contract to purchase a leading food processing and packing company in the private label products sector for both retail and institutional sales.

Annual sales of the soon to be acquired company are about $42 million. Combined with Stella Bella's annual sales of $5 million, it said it hopes to achieve 1,000 percent growth, reaching $55 million in sales in 1996 on a pro forma basis.
Terms were not disclosed. Pending closing of the escrow, a decision was reached not to disclose the name of the company. Stella Bella officials were not available.
Financing for the transaction was arranged and committed by a venture capital company that has provided financing for Stella Bella acquisitions.

Stella Bella said this latest acquisition will further facilitate its planned listing on the American or New York Stock Exchange. This purchase represents a valuable investment for Stella Bella since private label products are gaining in overall market share and profitability, it said.
